## Round 2 (scored 2026-10-21)

Predictions: `spe/predictions/r02.yaml` (saved before the run)
Results: `spe/evals/results/r02/r02.json` (40 tickets, 5 trials per cell)
Pass rate is `category_acc`.

| Metric | Predicted | Actual | Error | Baseline (same as last round) | Baseline error | Closer |

Mean absolute error on pass rates was 0.035 for our predictions and 0.030 for the baseline. The baseline beat us this round. The C miss accounts for the whole gap. Without C, our predictions beat the baseline (0.013 vs 0.027).

### Noise

The 5 trials of one ticket are not independent. So the real sample is closer to 40 tickets than 200 runs. At a pass rate near 0.85, one standard error is about 0.06 at the ticket level and about 0.025 at the run level.
- A and B are tied at 0.86. The B and A errors (0.02 and 0.01) are inside noise.
- D's error of 0.01 is inside noise.
- C's error of 0.10 is about 1.6 standard errors at the ticket level. The trace evidence in F4 makes it a real miss and not noise.

### Why claims

- B, "shorter prompt keeps focus": Not supported. B matched A on category (0.86 vs 0.86) and came within 0.01 on priority (0.78 vs 0.79). B did cost less ($0.009 vs $0.011 per ticket). The real B result is lower cost with no accuracy loss.
- C, "merged tools cut wrong tool choice": Refuted. C made fewer tool calls (2.6 vs 4.1 for A), but the calls it cut included needed ones. C never called `check_status` on 9 outage tickets. See F4.
- D, "same design on a smaller model loses about 0.15": Direction right, size a little high. D lost 0.12 on category and 0.13 on priority against A. The D cost prediction was off by 2x because D retried on long tickets. See F5.

### Changes for round 3 predictions

1. Predict a move away from the baseline only when a trace from an earlier round supports the mechanism. The C claim had no trace support.
2. Cost predictions must include a term for tickets over 2,000 words.
3. At 40 tickets, treat any gap under 0.06 as a tie. The other option is to raise the ticket count.

## F5. Variant D retries on tickets over 2,000 words

- Round: 2
